newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures dive on long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures dive on long liquidation.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended sharply lower across the board on Thursday on heavy long liquidation by overseas investors, traders said.
Prices ranged from 3.4 yen to 6.7 yen per kg lower. Benchmark September was off 3.4 yen at 135.9 yen.
The market started the day lower, with bearish sentiment carried over from the previous day.
"Selling pressure accelerated after the spot April contract fell below the 130 yen level," an analyst at a commodity broker said. Prices managed to avoid hitting their 7 yen per kg daily limit lows.
